lemmas.primary_translation: to take a broader view; to have a broader perspective

examples.no: hun løftet blikket og så seg rundt
examples.en: she lifted her gaze and looked around

definitions.translation: to have a broader perspective (lit. to lift one's gaze)

examples.no: nå er det viktig å løfte blikket og se framover
examples.en: now it is important to lift our gaze and look ahead
